properties.description:
Social Media | has contact: Yes

storm damage to commercial/industrial roof (heavy wet snow - roof and two walls collapsed) | Open - storm-damaged roof | 2026-11-27 (Hard Hat Report published 11/27; follow-ups from KMOV/Gray News and Spectrum News 11/27; first reported 11/26 by STLPR/FOX 2 - not listed in any prior run)
Heavy, wet Thanksgiving snow (6-8") collapsed part of the roof and two walls of the east rink at the city-owned Wentzville Ice Arena (67,800 SF, two NHL rinks, opened 1998) between 3-4 AM 11/26; building declared uninhabitable, facility closed, mayor calls it a "total loss" and says the city will rebuild (Board of Aldermen approval needed). NWS St. Louis LSR also logged the collapse.
